name: Forethought
summary: AI agents for customer support: answers, triage and agent assist.
description: Forethought automatically resolves part of customer requests, triages and routes tickets, and suggests replies to human agents. It connects to support tools such as Zendesk or Salesforce.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Forethought
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

summary_fr: Agents IA pour le support client : réponses, tri et assistance aux agents.
description_fr: Forethought résout automatiquement une partie des demandes clients, trie et route les tickets, et suggère des réponses aux agents humains. Il se connecte aux outils de support comme Zendesk ou Salesforce.
